observations: Photo 0: A large rusted industrial diesel engine block sits on wooden pallet blocks on muddy/dirt ground.
Front of engine shows a large toothed metal flywheel.
Multiple hoses, wires, and small gauges hang loosely from the engine body, some appearing disconnected.
A round badge/emblem is visible on the side of the engine block but the text is not legible in the photo.
Engine surface shows heavy rust, oxidation, and old oil/grease staining, especially near the base.
Behind the engine is a green painted generator canopy/enclosure with a small red electrical control box mounted on its side.
Other industrial items (a dark container, a white cylindrical tank) are visible in the background, partially cut off.
Ground is wet, muddy dirt, consistent with an outdoor storage/salvage yard.
